hero.subtitle: I help teams ship and sustain demanding products—less rework, more predictability, and a technical foundation ready for what comes next.

caseStudies.title: Core strengths
caseStudies.subtitle: Where I add the most value as a senior full-stack engineer: technical leadership on product delivery, digital commerce architecture, and production-grade services.

platforms.title: Platforms & product delivery
platforms.description: I steer architectural choices and the evolution of complex web platforms with cross-functional teams—emphasizing quality, operational stability, and a sustainable delivery cadence.
platforms.detail: Turn business priorities into clear technical direction, raise the bar on code and process (reviews, testing, automation), and support team growth through hands-on mentoring.
platforms.stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js / NestJS, automated testing, AWS, CI/CD (GitHub Actions)

commerce.title: Headless commerce & integration ecosystems
commerce.description: Strong command of decoupled e-commerce architectures—catalog, checkout, and operations wired to payments, logistics, and partners—with a focus on performance and long-term maintainability.
commerce.detail: Consistent API contracts, less coupling across channels, and reusable integrations so new surfaces ship faster without trading off reliability.
commerce.stack: PHP / Laravel, REST APIs, MySQL / MariaDB, payment & logistics integrations

apis.title: APIs, integrations & reliability
apis.description: Deep skills in designing and operating REST and GraphQL APIs, backend services, and business-critical integration flows—with disciplined error handling and production visibility.
apis.detail: Pragmatic versioning, containerized environments, observability, and practices that reduce incidents and time-to-diagnose when things go wrong.
apis.stack: Node.js / Express, GraphQL / REST, Docker, PostgreSQL, Redis, APM & structured logging

stack.title: The Engine Room
stack.subtitle: My technical stack is curated for scalability, maintainability, and performance.

legacy.title: Legacy Modernization
legacy.body: I specialize in transforming outdated monolithic architectures into modular, cloud-native systems without disrupting business operations.

maintainable.title: Maintainable Solutions
maintainable.body: Coding with the "next engineer" in mind. I prioritize clean, self-documenting code and robust automated testing frameworks.

ux.title: UI/UX Sensitivity
ux.body: Bridging the gap between design and engineering. I ensure the technical implementation never compromises the user experience.

about.title: I'm Leandro Zanardo.
about.subtitle: Building the backbone of modern digital experiences.
about.p1: Full-stack software engineer with 10+ years of experience building web applications, APIs, enterprise systems, dashboards, and digital products. My background combines Systems Analysis and Development, Graphic Design, and a postgraduate degree in Software Engineering.
about.p2: I work across architecture, legacy evolution, performance, observability, and UI/UX to deliver solutions that scale, stay reliable, and feel great to use.
